meta.name: evaluate
meta.description: Evaluate an AI workflow against representative cases and its permitted actions. Use for model, retrieval or agent evaluation; tests do not grant release authority.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用代表性案例检验 AI 工作流的表现,拿到可复核的评估结论。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在模型或智能体上线前做一次效果把关。
copy.tagline_en: Check an AI workflow against representative cases before you ship it.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to judge an AI model, retriever, or agent before release.

howto.what: 它会依据代表性用例和允许的动作来评估 AI 工作流，用于模型、检索或 agent 评估。开始前先读任务上下文契约和评估方法参考，如实报告缺失能力或未运行的检查；评估不授予发布权限。
howto.when: 当你需要做模型、检索或 agent 评估时进入；若由 @fde 调用，则复用其当前的脱敏数据包与范围，不重做已答过的设置或发现。

say.text: 按代表性用例评估这个 AI 工作流
say.note: 会先读任务上下文契约与评估方法

say.text: 评估这个检索流程在其允许的动作范围内
say.note: 如实报告缺失能力与未运行的检查

say.text: 评估这个 agent 工作流，保留未知项
say.note: 区分实现、验证、部署与验收

howto.what_en: It evaluates an AI workflow against representative cases and permitted actions, for model, retrieval or agent evaluation. It reads the task context contract and eval method and reports unrun checks honestly; tests grant no release authority.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need model, retrieval or agent evaluation; when called by @fde it reuses its current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: Evaluate this AI workflow against representative cases.
say_en.note: Reads the task context contract and eval method first.

say_en.text: Assess this retrieval flow within its permitted actions.
say_en.note: Reports missing capabilities and unrun checks honestly.

say_en.text: Evaluate this agent workflow and preserve unknowns.
say_en.note: Keeps implementation, verification, deployment and acceptance apart.
